[P1] 再见，GRACIE
GRUMPOSARUS
坏脾气
[英] 布莱恩·摩西◎著 [英] 迈克·戈登◎绘
王甜甜 吕海涛◎译
手机淘宝扫一扫

[P2] 小恐龙格蕾西脾气不好，一天到晚牢骚不断。
Gracie Grumposaurus was always grumpy.
从早晨起床到夜晚临睡，
格蕾西一直在发脾气。
First thing in the morning till last
thing at night, Gracie was a grump.

[P3] 当她妈妈掀开她的恐龙羽绒被时，
她会抱怨说：“我不想起床。”
"I don't want to get up," she grumped,
when her mum pulled off her dino-duvet.

[P4] 当妈妈按照她的要求——不太软，蛋液也不太稀——
做好翼龙蛋之后，她又不耐烦地说：“我不想吃翼龙蛋。”
“I don't want a pteradactyl's egg,” she grumped,
after her mum had cooked it just the way
she liked it - not too runny and not too soft.

[P5] “所有的玩具都让我感到厌烦。”她在房间里转来转去，
一脸不高兴地说道，一边说一边还用她那
又短又粗的尾巴重重地扫打地上的玩具。
“I'm fed up with all my toys,” she grumped, spinning round
and round and knocking them over with her stubby tail.

[P6] 当妈妈带她去恐龙商店的时候，每个人
见到她们都会停下来说：“格蕾西，
今天过得开心吗？”
When her mother took her to the
Dinostore, everyone would
stop them and say,
“How's Gracie today?”
这时，格蕾西就会拉下脸，摆出一副“我不高兴”的表情。
“我想，她大概是累了。”格蕾西的妈妈总是这样替她辩解。
And Gracie would pull her best grumposaurus face.
“I think she's tired,” Gracie's mum always said.

[P7] 在恐龙商店，格蕾西从购物车里拿起一罐根茎汁。
“我不想要这个。”说完，只听到“啪嗒”
一声！那盒根茎汁就掉到了地上。
In the Dinostore, Gracie pulled
a carton of root juice out of
the trolley. "I don't want
that," and SPLAT!, it
landed on the floor.

无论妈妈想买什么，格蕾西都统统不想买。
Whatever Gracie's mum wanted to buy, Gracie didn't.

[P8] 从早到晚，格蕾西始终板着脸，不高兴。
Gracie was grumpy all day long.
“我不想去外面玩。”她发牢骚。
“I don't want to play outside,” she grumbled.

[P9] “我不想吃绿油油的粗燕麦粥。”格蕾西抱怨说。
“I don't want grassy grits for my dinner,” Gracie moaned.

[P10] “我想看电视里播的《噩梦恐龙》。”格蕾西没好气地说道。
“I want to watch 'Nightmare Dinosaur' on television,” Gracie grumped.
“啊，这个你可不能看，格蕾西。你还没长大。”她爸爸答道。
“Well, you can't, Gracie. You're not old enough,” her dad said.

[P11] 就连洗澡的时候，格蕾西也依旧牢骚满腹。
“我不想看到这个放在这里。”她说。话音未落，
一个玩具鸭就被她丢到了屋子的另一端。
Gracie was grumpy in her bath, too. “I don't want that in
here,” she said, flinging her toy duck across the room.

[P12] 终于，格蕾西穿着她最好的睡衣，舒舒服服地窝在了自己的小床上。这时，格蕾西的妈妈想给她讲一个《霸王龙的烦恼》的故事。
Then, finally, when Gracie was tucked up in bed in her very best pyjamas, Gracie's mum tried to read her a story called 'Tyrannosaurus Trouble'.
“我不想听这个故事！”她扯着嗓子尖叫道。
“I don't want that book,” she screeched.

[P13] “哦，格蕾西，”她妈妈说，“你为什么
总是这么多牢骚呢？你难道就不能
当一天微笑的格蕾西吗？
“Oh Gracie,” said her mum. “Why are
you always such a grump-osaurus?
Couldn’t you just one day be
Gracie Grin-osaurus?
很久很久以来，
坏脾气的格蕾西第一次……
And, for the first time
in a very long time,
Gracie Grumposaurus…

[P14] ……露出了笑容！
…SMILED!

[P2] The little dinosaur Gracie had a bad temper and complained all day long.
Gracie Grumposaurus was always grumpy.
From the moment she woke up in the morning until bedtime at night,
Gracie was always grumpy.
First thing in the morning till last
thing at night, Gracie was a grump.

[P3] When her mum pulled off her dino-duvet,
she would grumble, "I don't want to get up."
"I don't want to get up," she grumped,
when her mum pulled off her dino-duvet.

[P4] When her mum cooked the pteradactyl's egg just the way she liked it — not too soft, and not too runny — she grumbled, "I don't want to eat a pteradactyl's egg."
"I don't want a pteradactyl's egg," she grumped,
after her mum had cooked it just the way
she liked it - not too runny and not too soft.

[P5] "All my toys make me feel annoyed," she said, turning around and around in the room, her face unhappy, while at the same time using her short, thick tail to knock over the toys on the floor.
"I'm fed up with all my toys," she grumped, spinning round and round and knocking them over with her stubby tail.

[P6] When her mother took her to the Dinostore, everyone would stop them and say, "How's Gracie today?"
At this point, Gracie would pull down her face, making her best 'I'm not happy' expression.
"I think she's tired," Gracie's mum always said.
And Gracie would pull her best grumposaurus face.
"I think she's tired," Gracie's mum always said.

[P7] In the Dinostore, Gracie pulled a carton of root juice out of the trolley. "I don't want that," and SPLAT!, it landed on the floor.

Whatever Gracie's mum wanted to buy, Gracie didn't.

[P8] From morning till night, Gracie kept her face scowling and was unhappy.
Gracie was grumpy all day long.
"I don't want to play outside," she grumbled.
"I don't want to play outside," she grumbled.

[P9] "I don't want to eat the green, grassy grits," Gracie complained.
"I don't want grassy grits for my dinner," Gracie moaned.

[P10] "I want to watch 'Nightmare Dinosaur' on television," Gracie grumped.
"Well, you can't, Gracie. You're not old enough," her dad said.

[P11] Even when taking a bath, Gracie was still full of complaints.
"I don't want to see this here," she said. Before the words had even finished,
a toy duck was flung by her to the other end of the room.
Gracie was grumpy in her bath, too. "I don't want that in
here," she said, flinging her toy duck across the room.

[P12] Finally, Gracie was tucked up in bed in her very best pyjamas, cozy and comfortable in her little bed. At this moment, Gracie's mum tried to read her a story called 'Tyrannosaurus Trouble'.
"I don't want to hear this story!" she screamed, straining her voice.
"I don't want that book," she screeched.

[P13] "Oh, Gracie," said her mum. "Why are you always so grumpy? Couldn't you just be a smiling Gracie for one day?"
"Oh Gracie," said her mum. "Why are you always such a grump-osaurus? Couldn't you just one day be Gracie Grin-osaurus?"
And, for the first time in a very long time, Gracie Grumposaurus...

[P14] ……smiled!
…SMILED!

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《再见，坏脾气》的封面，展示了一只戴着粉色蝴蝶结的绿色小恐龙坐在岩石上，旁边有水杯和灯笼，画面下方有二维码和资源信息。
[P2] 本页介绍了小恐龙格蕾西脾气暴躁、整天发牢骚的性格特点，并通过左右两幅插图分别展示了她白天和夜晚的暴躁行为。
[P3] 小恐龙格蕾西在妈妈掀开她的恐龙羽绒被时，抱怨不想起床，画面展示了她赖床的场景。
[P4] 小恐龙格蕾西在妈妈按照她的要求煮好翼龙蛋后，仍然不耐烦地表示不想吃，展现了她任性又爱发牢骚的性格。
[P5] 小恐龙格蕾西在房间里生气地转圈，用尾巴扫倒所有玩具，表现出她对玩具的厌烦和暴躁情绪。
[P6] 本页描绘了小恐龙格蕾西和妈妈去恐龙商店时，大家都会关心地询问她的心情，而她总是摆出不高兴的表情，妈妈则解释说她可能累了。
[P7] 在恐龙商店，小恐龙格蕾西从购物车里拿出一罐根茎汁后，因不想买而将其扔在地上，表现出她任性、不愿配合的性格。无论妈妈想买什么，她都拒绝购买。
[P8] 本页描绘了小恐龙格蕾西在户外与其他恐龙一起时，始终板着脸、不高兴，并抱怨不想去外面玩，展现了她持续的坏脾气。
[P9] 小恐龙格蕾西在晚餐时抱怨不想吃绿油油的粗燕麦粥，表现出她一贯的任性与不合作态度，而她的家人则在旁边用餐。
[P10] 小恐龙格蕾西想看电视节目《噩梦恐龙》，但爸爸以她年纪太小为由拒绝了她的请求。
[P11] 小恐龙格蕾西在洗澡时依然心情不好，抱怨不想看到玩具鸭，并将其扔到房间另一端，展现了她持续的任性与不合作态度。
[P12] 小恐龙格蕾西穿着睡衣躺在床上，妈妈想给她读《霸王龙的烦恼》故事，但她大声拒绝，表现出一贯的任性与不合作态度。
[P13] 格蕾西的妈妈询问她为何总是不开心，希望她能当一天微笑的格蕾西，而画面显示格蕾西第一次在很久以来有了不同的反应。
[P14] 小恐龙格蕾西在妈妈的询问后，终于露出了久违的笑容，周围绽放出庆祝般的烟花，象征着她情绪的转变。
